fields.Name: CRD-04 - Operations
fields.Description: Verify the server-side operations that span several records: creating a program with its first version, copying a version into a new draft, reordering a version's tree and setting up an organization, each as one unit of work that leaves nothing behind when refused, including under concurrent calls.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All ten cred-operations checks pass on scratch programs and run-unique organizations; the sample program is left unchanged.
